notes.title: SNOWBOARD LEAGUE IS LEAVING EARLY ACCESS
notes.notes: The full release is finally here. After being in beta for a little while now, I was able to test the game and get feedback. I am now comfortable taking the game out of Early Access. I will continue adding cosmetics, maps, and features in the future through free updates. Thank you to everyone who provided feedback and helped me test new features.

notes.title: Snowboard League BETA releases with a COMPLETE OVERHAUL!
notes.notes:
The Beta Version of Snowboard League is now public! I wasn't happy with the state of the game, so I overhauled the entire project to resemble my vision of what the game will look like on the final release. 
There are lots of changes to the maps, all the menus, the playermodel and its customizations, that I am really happy with! I was gone for a while to work on other projects. During that time I learned a lot, and I hope it shows with this update!
But there is still a lot to do, a lot to add, and a lot to look forward to.
So look forward to more updates in the near future!

Sadly, I had to cut some content like the freeroam lobby, the snowball fight minigame, and the autumn freefall track, but perhaps they will return in later updates!

Also, thank you to anyone and everyone who has played the game so far, I hope you enjoy this update!

Cheers,
dibo <3

notes.title: ALPHA 61
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Introducing AI Snowboarders![/b][/h1]
[previewyoutube=ZREYfoNADXg;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]This update adds AI opponents that you can race against[/i]

The AI Snowboarders are still a work in progress. Keep in mind that there are a few known issues. The AI snowboarders might have some small problems, like getting stuck, forming a conga line at the start of a round, or crashing into walls at mach speed. But it shouldn't take long for them to become a little smarter! 

[b]How does it work?[/b]
The AI works by using a [u]"Feedforward Neural Network"[/u] paired with [u]"Fitness-Based Selection"[/u].

The [u]"Feedforward Neural Network"[/u] is a very simple algorithm. To keep it brief, it takes information as an input layer, then uses so-called "weights", which act as some kind of DNA for our AI, to change around the input data and then use that shuffled input data to perform tasks inside the output layer. There are multiple so-called "hidden layers" in which the information is being shuffled. Every AI agent has a different set of weights. The AI that performs best will have its weight passed on to the next generation. Where its weights have a slight random amount subtracted from or added to them. This is commonly referred to as a "mutation". And this process is repeated and tweaked until our AI more or less performs the way you want it to. In this current version of the game, the AI has its weights from approximately Generation 200, which is comparatively unadvanced. 

Then this was combined with [u]"Fitness-Based Selection"[/u]; a common method in machine learning where an AI agent gets rewarded a certain "fitness score" when it performs well and gets points deducted when it performs badly. At the end of a generational cycle, the AI agent with the best score passes on to the next generation. 

So, to sum it up, we have a [u]"Feedforward Neural Network"[/u] that processes environmental data and generates button presses. The weights of the network are adjusted through evolutionary processes like [u]"Fitness-Based Selection"[/u] and mutation. The fitness scores, obtained through [u]"Fitness-Based Selection"[/u], determine which individuals pass their weights on to the next generation, leading to the evolution and improvement of AI agents over time. 

[b]What is it for?[/b]
If you wish to practice and enhance your racing skills in multiplayer races, add a competitive edge to your gameplay experience when playing with friends, or seek challenging competition even when playing alone, this update is for you. 

There is much more to come. Wishlist the game to keep updated for new features!
